reasoning: core/tls_trust.py implements exactly the described behaviour: per-host trust-on-first-use capture and pinning of self-signed certificates, plus an explicit CA bundle override that takes precedence over pinning. The module is complete with error classification, retry logic, and a diagnostic helper, indicating the work is finished rather than in progress.

evidence.why: Captures the server's presented certificate and writes it as a per-host PEM under CONFIG_DIR/trusted_certs, i.e. auto-trust on first use.
Returns the configured CA bundle when present, otherwise the pinned per-host cert, otherwise certifi default — the CA bundle override precedence.
Wraps requests calls, retrying once with a freshly pinned certificate on a trust-chain SSLError, and skipping recovery when an explicit CA bundle is set.
Distinguishes recoverable trust-chain failures from other TLS errors such as expiry or hostname mismatch.
